headline: Watch the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer, featuring the debut of “Flower in a Hurrican
body: Watch the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer, featuring the debut of “Flower in a Hurricane” from original score composers score artists Justice feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19. Visit rockstargames. com/VI/ps5 to learn more.
